data.name: Point Shooter
data.detailed_description:
Point Shooter is a fast-paced arcade shooter built around movement, shooting, scoring, and survival.

Collect point orbs, fight off enemies, and keep yourself alive as the game pushes back harder over time. The more points players collect, the more intense the match becomes, turning each run into a fight to stay ahead.

Jump In And Start Shooting

Move quickly, fire at incoming enemies, and grab points before the arena becomes too dangerous. Point Shooter is designed to be easy to start, but harder to keep under control once the action builds.

Score, Survive, Repeat

Every run is about pushing your score higher. Collect points, avoid danger zones, and try to last longer than your previous attempt.

Steam Multiplayer Support

Host or join lobbies using Steam networking. Play with friends, ready up in the lobby, and jump into a shared match.

Features

  • Fast arcade shooter gameplay
  • Point-orb collection and score chasing
  • Enemy spawning that scales with player progress
  • Solo play and Steam lobby support
  • Player stats menu
  • Custom settings and control binding menus

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX 570 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows-compatible audio device
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system. Internet connection required for Steam multiplayer.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 580 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows-compatible audio device
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for smoother performance at 1080p.
